title: 以帳密預設驗證收據取代 rollout 的舊 OAuth 人工 gate

retarget_decision.rationale: Following the merge and verification of password-first authentication and optional OIDC deployment, the dev/staging/prod rollout dependency on the legacy human OAuth gate is retargeted to verified password-first security receipts. Google OAuth is repositioned as an optional enablement task rather than a deployment prerequisite.

canonical_dependency_mutation.message: 以已完成之 ODP-WEB-PASSWORD-FIRST-SECURITY-E2E-002 帳密預設安全驗收取代舊 Human OAuth gate 依賴

ODP-WEB-PASSWORD-FIRST-SECURITY-E2E-002.verified_evidence: Web route suite 53 files / 474 tests passed; Python security E2E, login throttle wiring, conditional OIDC, and Terraform contract checks passed. Secret values redacted.

ODP-WEB-OIDC-OPTIONAL-DEPLOYMENT-001.verified_evidence: Conditional OIDC Terraform & workflow validation passed; local password default requires no Google OAuth client or secret.

ODP-DEV-LIVE-ROLLOUT-REMEDIATION-001.previous_blocker: HUMAN-GCP-WEB-OAUTH-CLIENTS-001 (Human operator creating GCP Secret Manager web OIDC client secrets)

HUMAN-GCP-WEB-OAUTH-CLIENTS-001.note: Retained for future operator enablement of Google OIDC provider; not a prerequisite for local password-first deployment.

rollout_gates_preserved: Candidate-Built / Build Once Gate (Cosign, CycloneDX SBOM, Bandit SAST, Secret scan)
Dev-Verified / Dev Integration Gate (API/Web authenticated health, Direct VPC, provider-off, default-deny egress)
Staging-Verified / Ephemeral Staging 9-Stage Rehearsal Gate (isolated DB, tenant, masked snapshot, rollback rehearsal)
Prod-Admitted / Production Blue-Green Gate (0% candidate smoke, 100% atomic switch, Human GO, backup checkpoint)
